goal: Is ke baad aap parameters (formal) ko arguments (actual) se alag pehchaan sakein ge, function ko sahi tadaad, tarteeb aur types ke arguments ke saath call kar sakein ge, return hui value ko expressions mein use kar sakein ge, aur woh function samajh sakein ge jo kisi doosre function ko call karta hai.
warmup: Aap juice shop par order dete hain: 'Do mango juice, aur ek mein cheeni nahi.' Order slip par khaali dibbe hain: kitne, kaun sa flavour, cheeni ya nahi. Yeh khaali dibbe PARAMETERS hain. Jo aap counter par bolte hain, 'do, mango, cheeni nahi', woh ARGUMENTS hain. Dukaandaar aap ke alfaaz ko position ke hisaab se dibbon mein likhta hai: pehla jawab pehle dibbe mein. Agar aap tarteeb badal dein to ghalat juice mil sakta hai!
definition: Parameter (jis ko formal parameter bhi kehte hain) function ke header mein ek variable hota hai jo value receive karta hai, jaise int add(int x, int y) mein x aur y. Argument (jis ko actual parameter bhi kehte hain) woh value hai jo function call mein likhi jati hai, jaise add(a, b) mein a aur b. Jab function call hota hai to har argument evaluate hota hai aur phir us ke saamne wale parameter mein COPY ho jata hai. Matching position se hoti hai, naam se nahi. Arguments ki tadaad parameters ki tadaad ke barabar honi chahiye, aur har argument ka type us ke parameter ke type ke saath compatible hona chahiye.
howItWorks: Traces step by step chalayein aur call stack dekhein. Call par har parameter ke liye ek naya box ban jata hai aur har argument ki value us mein copy ho jati hai. Function sirf apni copies ke saath kaam karta hai, is liye function ke andar parameter badalne se caller ka variable nahi badalta (agla lesson isay theek se samjhayega). Arguments seedhi values ho sakte hain (add(100, 250)), variables (add(a, b)) ya expressions (add(2 * 5, y + 1)): expression pehle calculate hota hai. Tarteeb ahem hai: subtract(10, 3) aur subtract(3, 10) ke jawab alag hote hain. Agar argument ka type parameter ke type se alag ho to C++ usay convert kar deta hai. 9.8 jaisa double agar int parameter mein jaye to 9 ban jata hai, aur decimal hissa zaya ho jata hai, is liye isse bachein. Function ki return ki hui value print ho sakti hai, kisi variable mein store ho sakti hai, bare expression ke andar use ho sakti hai, ya kisi doosre function ko argument ke taur par di ja sakti hai. Ek function doosre function ko call kar sakta hai: doosra call stack ke upar rakha jata hai, pehle khatam hota hai, aur pehle function ke paas wapas jata hai.
